standard: British (BS EN 10365 / BS 4-1, BS EN 10056-1, BS EN 10210-2, BS EN 10219-2)
edition: SCI P363 'Steel Building Design: Design Data' (Blue Book), Eurocode (UK NA) edition tables
source: Published tables (see 'sources' and skyframe/docs/SECTION_SOURCES.md). Values not printed by the source are computed exactly from the published dimensions and listed per shape in 'computed'.

sources.BB: SCI/BCSA 'Steel Building Design: Design Data' (Blue Book, SCI P363, Eurocode edition; BS EN 10365 / BS 4-1 open sections, BS EN 10056-1 angles, BS EN 10210-2 / BS EN 10219-2 hollow sections) as transcribed in jsbayley/gazelle @eff4332 (AGPL-3.0), src/.d/bluebook/properties/*.json

conventions: local 3 = major axis, 2 = minor; I-shapes/channels/tees: d along local 2 (tees: flange on top, I33 about the axis parallel to the flange, so I33 < I22 is possible). Channels: back of web at 3=0, flanges toward +3. Angles: heel at origin, leg d along +2, leg b along +3; I33/I22 about leg-parallel centroidal axes, alpha = angle (rad) from local 3 to the major principal axis, positive toward +2. x0/y0 = shear centre minus centroid along 3/2. As2 = d*tw, As3 = 5/3*bf*tf (I/channel), 5/6*bf*tf (tee); 5/6*d*t, 5/6*b*t (angle); 2*d*t, 2*b*t (RHS); A/2 (CHS). Hollow-section corner radii (dims r_out/r_in) are the calculation radii of BS EN 10210-2 (1.5t / 1.0t) and BS EN 10219-2 (2t/2.5t/3t, r_out - t).
